# CLI reference

<!-- Generated by `cargo xtask docs generate` from each binary's `--help`. Do not edit by hand. -->

Every command and subcommand, with its `--help` output. The `pal` CLI is still a placeholder (#189); its commands appear here as they are added.

## `palisade-server`

```text
Palisade central management server.

Usage: palisade-server [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  serve         Run the server until SIGTERM or Ctrl-C
  check-config  Validate the configuration, the TLS files and the certificate names, then print the effective configuration (secrets redacted)
  version       Print the version
  migrate       Manage the database schema. Uses the `[database.migration]` login (the schema owner) for `up`, and either login for the others
  help          Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -c, --config <PATH>  Path to the TOML configuration file [env: PALISADE_CONFIG=]
  -h, --help           Print help
  -V, --version        Print version
```

## `palisade-server migrate`

```text
Manage the database schema. Uses the `[database.migration]` login (the schema owner) for `up`, and either login for the others

Usage: palisade-server migrate [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

Commands:
  up      Apply every pending migration, then verify the schema
  status  Print the applied and embedded migrations as JSON. Exits 0 when the schema is current, 3 when migrations are pending, 1 otherwise
  verify  Check that the applied migrations match this binary byte for byte, and that every tenant table has row-level security forced. Exits 0 when everything matches, 1 otherwise
  help    Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
  -c, --config <PATH>  Path to the TOML configuration file [env: PALISADE_CONFIG=]
  -h, --help           Print help
```

## `palisade-agent`

```text
Usage: palisade-agent (--console | --service) [--config <path>]
       palisade-agent --help | --version

Modes:
  --console          Run in the foreground until Ctrl-C (any OS).
  --service          Run under the Windows service control manager.
                     The installer registers the service with this flag.

Options:
  --config <path>    Configuration file. Without it, the agent reads
                     %ProgramData%\Palisade\agent.toml on Windows if it
                     exists, and uses built-in defaults otherwise.
  -h, --help         Print this help.
  -V, --version      Print the version.
```
